item.rplights.hand_lantern.desc: Spotlight with a handle. Incandescent bulb: warm light that dims and turns orange as the batteries run down.
item.rplights.old_flashlight.desc: Chrome, converted to an LED. Moody: flickers, does not always turn on, hates water.
item.rplights.headlamp.desc: Curios head slot shines where you look, body slot where your body faces. Hands stay free.
item.rplights.dynamo_flashlight.desc: Squeeze light: shines while you pump the lever. No batteries.
item.rplights.hurricane_lamp.desc: Kerosene, shines all round. Carry it in hand or on the belt (Curios belt slot). Goes out in water.
item.rplights.accumulator.desc: Recharges in a charger. Holds less than a regular battery and wears out over time.
item.rplights.battery_tester.desc: Right-click: test the battery, cell or flashlight in your other hand.
rplights.tip.use.hand_lantern: Right-click: on/off. Sneak+right-click: batteries in the other hand - swap, a bulb - screw in, empty hand - take the batteries out.
rplights.tip.use.old_flashlight: Right-click: on/off (not always the first time). Sneak+right-click: batteries in the other hand - swap, empty hand - take out.
rplights.tip.use.headlamp: Worn: key L. In hand: right-click on/off, sneak+right-click with batteries - swap, empty hand - take out.
rplights.tip.use.uv_flashlight: Right-click: on/off. Sneak+right-click: batteries in the other hand - swap, empty hand - take out.
rplights.tip.use.rgb_flashlight: Right-click: on/off. Sneak+right-click: batteries - swap, empty hand - next mode.
rplights.tip.use.dynamo_flashlight: Right-click: pump the lever, each adds a few seconds of light. Costs a little stamina.
rplights.tip.use.hurricane_lamp: Right-click: light/put out. Sneak+right-click: kerosene bucket in the other hand - refuel, empty hand - wick.
rplights.tip.use.sa: Sneak+right-click: battery in the other hand - swap, empty hand - low/high beam.
rplights.msg.swollen: The cell is swollen - unsafe to charge
rplights.msg.nothing_worn: No lamp on head, chest or belt
rplights.tester.nothing: Nothing to test in the other hand
